label: Затылок
description: A 10-sentence usage card for затылок (back of head).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Затылок' is a masculine noun in the nominative, the subject of 'болит'. The frame 'у меня' shows whose back of the head aches.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Затылок' is the accusative direct object of 'почесал'; as an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative form. A classic gesture of puzzlement.

missions.phrase: У него нет волос на затылке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location with genitive of negation. 'На затылке' is the prepositional form showing where the hair is, while 'нет волос' uses the genitive of absence.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На затылок' uses the accusative after 'на' to show motion onto the back of the head. 'Шапка' is the nominative subject that slid back.
Strategic focus: Accusative with 'в'. 'В затылок' uses the accusative to show the wind hitting the back of the head. 'Мне' is the dative of the affected person.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'с'. 'С затылка' uses the genitive form 'затылка' to show movement away from the back of the head. 'Волосы' is the accusative object of 'убрала'.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К затылку' uses the dative form to show pressing the ice toward the back of the head. 'Лёд' is the accusative object of 'прижал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Затылком' is the instrumental form showing the body part with which he hit the wall. 'О стену' marks the surface struck.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Затылки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Чистые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'у детей' shows whose backs of the head are clean.
Strategic focus: Nominative agent. 'Затылок' is the nominative subject performing the action 'защищает'. 'Заднюю часть' is the accusative object naming what it protects.
